description: This Java class implements Spring Security's UserDetailsService to load user details for authentication, retrieving user data from a UserService and converting user roles into Spring Security authorities.

classes.name: SpringDataUserDetailsService
classes.description: A service class implementing UserDetailsService to bridge between the application's user data and Spring Security.

methods.name: setUserService
methods.description: Setter method for injecting UserService dependency, annotated with @Autowired.

methods.name: loadUserByUsername
methods.description: Loads user details by username (email), converts roles into authorities, and returns a Spring Security User object.
